record.paper_title: Some open questions and conjectures about visibility and iteration in bounded convex domains in ℂ^N
record.original_question: Fix z_0 ∈ Ω for a bounded convex domain Ω ⊂ ℂ^N, and let G_{z_0} be the family of all geodesic segments and geodesic rays starting from z_0, parametrized by hyperbolic arc-length. Is visibility of Ω equivalent to uniform equicontinuity of this family G_{z_0} as maps from [0,+∞) with its Euclidean topology into ℂ^N with its Euclidean topology?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.11. Let Ω ⊂ C^N be a bounded convex domain. Then Ω is visible if and only if Gz0 is uniformly equicontinuous (as family of functions from [0, +∞) endowed with the Euclidean topology to C^N endowed with the Euclidean topology).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^N$ be a bounded convex domain, equipped with its Kobayashi distance $k_\Omega$. A geodesic segment (respectively, geodesic ray) in $\Omega$ is an isometric map $\gamma\colon I \to (\Omega, k_\Omega)$ where $I \subset \mathbb{R}$ is a compact interval (respectively, $I=[0,+\infty)$), parametrized by hyperbolic arc-length. The domain $\Omega$ is said to be visible if for every pair of distinct boundary points $p, q \in \partial\Omega$ there exist neighborhoods $U_p$ of $p$ and $U_q$ of $q$ in $\mathbb{C}^N$ with $\overline{U_p}\cap\overline{U_q}=\emptyset$ and a compact subset $K \subset \Omega$ such that every geodesic segment in $\Omega$ joining a point of $U_p\cap\Omega$ to a point of $U_q\cap\Omega$ intersects $K$.

Fix a basepoint $z_0 \in \Omega$, and let $\mathcal{G}_{z_0}$ denote the family of all geodesic segments and geodesic rays of $(\Omega, k_\Omega)$ starting at $z_0$, each parametrized by hyperbolic arc-length and extended (if necessary) so that its domain is contained in $[0,+\infty)$. Regard each element of $\mathcal{G}_{z_0}$ as a map from $[0,+\infty)$ (with its Euclidean topology) into $\mathbb{C}^N$ (with its Euclidean topology).

Determine whether $\Omega$ is visible if and only if the family $\mathcal{G}_{z_0}$ is uniformly equicontinuous.
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is posed as a conjecture in a 2025 list of open questions on visibility and iteration in bounded convex domains in ℂ^N. Web search returns the conjecture itself and related work on visibility (e.g., visible C^2-smooth domains are pseudoconvex, visibility of Kobayashi geodesics in convex domains) but no source claiming a proof or disproof of the equivalence between visibility and uniform equicontinuity of the geodesic family G_{z_0}.
